newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.01 pct in Feb - Fipe.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.01 pct in Feb - Fipe.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.01 percent in February, down from 1.23 percent in January, a Fipe official said.
Juarez Rizzieri, president of Fipe, said lower education costs, food and transport prices slowed the price index, which measures costs in the city of Sao Paulo.
Transport costs fell 0.22 percent in the period, while education costs were down 0.18 percent and food prices only increased 0.76 percent.
Rizzieri said he expected the March Fipe index to be around 0.2 percent.
The Fipe index measuring inflation in the last 12 months was 8.98 percent, he said.
He gave the following breakdown of the Fipe weighted index for the period.
- Food 0.76 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
